name: CSG Distance Field Evaluation (Single Point)
definition: A recursive algorithm to compute the signed distance from a single point to a CSG tree, supporting Union, Intersection, Difference, Replace, Translation, Rotation, Plane, Cylinder, Sphere, and Box primitives.
summary: CSG Distance Field Evaluation (Single Point) computes the signed distance from one point to a CSG tree, differing from batched variants by processing a single coordinate vector.
